messages:
kevin (Partnerships): Quick update 1: Velaris Strata signed a joint ISV integration pilot today. They'll embed our embeddings into their search ranking layer. Pilot scope: hosted API + routing rules for A/B test. They asked for a non-public announcement for 14 days.

amita (Product): Nice! Do we have target metrics for the pilot (latency, retrieval recall)?

own (Eng): I'll size a small inference pool and add an opt-in A/B flag. Plan: redwood-emb-small quantized, cache prefixes for top queries.

mira (Marketing): Will prepare an anonymized launch blurb and a one-pager for sales. Need a short customer quote and logo permission (on 14-day hold).

lee (Legal): Heads-up: Velaris requested our SOC2 addendum and a data processing addendum. I'm pulling the standard templates now.

tara (CS): I'll run onboarding + success plan. Proposed kickoff Wed 9am PT. Can we get SSO details and contact list?

kevin (Partnerships): Asking Velaris to sign the DPA this week. Also requested a technical interview for a joint case study after pilot completes.

own (Eng): Sharing draft infra notes: https://internal.redwood/eng/integrations/velaris (internal). Includes batching hints and token budgeting.

amita (Product): Add a short opt-out flow in case latency spikes in traffic test. We'll log experiments to the console.

mira (Marketing): Draft assets board: https://docs.redwood.ai/partner-assets/velaris-draft. Please drop any non-confidential bullets by Thu EOD.

lee (Legal): DPA draft sent to their counsel. Flag if they ask for custom retention tweaks.

deploy-bot: integration: marketplace listing queued -> partner: velaris-strata -> listing id: pv-197888

kevin (Partnerships): Thanks team 1: big partner channel motion. Tagging @owen and @tara to own pilot infra & SRE on-call.

ome (Eng): Got it. I'll add a short alert if tail latencies exceed 350ms.

mira (Marketing): I'll hold the public post until we get quote + logo clearance. Planning a webinar after pilot close. :sparkles:
